title: Reset demo still strands non-dashboard routes on a permanent skeleton — the 'reset navigates home' fold did not land (still present since round 1)
evidence: demo_update.gleam:642 fn reset_demo(model: Model) ... 655: vacancy_detail: NotAsked, ... 658: comparison_details: NotAsked, 659: archived_vacancies: NotAsked, ... effect: demo_api.fetch_notifications(store, ApiReturnedNotifications) — no modem.push. vacancy_detail.gleam:26: NotAsked | Loading -> view_loading()
detail: Reset wipes detail state but neither navigates nor refetches the current route; the banner reset is global chrome, so resetting from vacancy/applicant/comparison/archived pages leaves a perpetual loading skeleton — exactly r1 #13.

title: pdf_prebake header still documents the ignored CLI arg and still exits 0 on failure (r1 #20 half-landed)
evidence: pdf_prebake.gleam:11-12: "////   gleam run -m demo/pdf_prebake -- server/priv\n////   (cwd = server/; the arg is the priv dir. ..." — main() reads only envoy.get("RT_DEMO_PRIV_DIR") (argv ignored). Failure tail: 'case failures { 0 -> io.println(...) _ -> io.println("FAILED: " <> ...) }' — no halt/exit; grep 'halt|sys.exit|process' in the file: no matches.
detail: The env override landed, but the module doc still tells maintainers to pass a CLI arg the code ignores, and a failed regeneration prints 'FAILED' then exits 0 — scripted rebuilds cannot detect broken PDFs.
recommended_fix: Fix the header doc to document RT_DEMO_PRIV_DIR only; call process.halt(1) (or erlang halt) when failures > 0.
